---
title: "Git tools"
---

Install Git, Git LFS, Gitk, [GitHub CLI](github_cli.qmd), and the shared global Git defaults.

```sh
ansible-playbook -i inventory -K playbooks/lab-stack.yml --tags git
```

::: {.callout-manual}
**🔧 Manual setup and configuration**

Configure your identity and register SSH or GPG keys with your Git hosting provider. The role deliberately does not set a name, email address, or credentials.
:::

::: {.callout-check}
**✅ Check**

```sh
git --version
git lfs version
gh --version
git config --global init.defaultBranch
```
:::

Use Git for local and version-control operations such as commits, branches, merges, tags, and push or pull. Use GitHub CLI (`gh`) for GitHub-specific operations such as pull requests, issues, Actions, repositories, and releases. See [GitHub CLI](github_cli.qmd) for authentication and common commands.
